notes: Self-declared '3d incremental game' with a throw, sell, upgrade-luck-and-multiplier loop, which is Simulation; nothing else is doing real work, so secondary is empty. Took space-bounded from outside Simulation's typical list because the author's answer pins the whole game to one small single-level park plaza with a lake at the centre and the three shops on its rim — world-open, the genre default, promises a contiguous explorable map traversed in any order, and this is one enclosed plaza instead. Kept the Incremental Simulator preset with that shape substituted and its gate-progression dropped, since there are no higher-tier zones to wall off — every shop is on the same rim from the start — while social-hub carries the three-shop storefront cluster and path-circulation the walk between the water's edge and the shops; trigger-task carries the coin-throwing stations along the lake rim, and water-body carries the lake itself. Decided without a user that nobody swims — players stand at the edge and toss coins in — so the water is a flat surface feature and its CHECK raises nothing, leaving the build on P0, and the author's answer that the game loops forever means there is deliberately no terminating exit or winner zone.
